tips.text: Servi's Act 3 choice is permanent — Stun Threshold is the popular pick.
Field vendors guarantee a rare: gloves (Jungle Ruins), boots (Infested Barrens), armour (Chimeral Wetlands).
Dodge roll through the Soul Core's placement animation in the Trial of Chaos to duplicate it into every socket.
Hold Ctrl on the passive tree to auto-confirm points.

objectives.text: Talk to The Hooded One
Kill Rootdredge
Basket at the Orok Campsite
Hanging tree corpse
Enter the Ziggurat Encampment
Talk to Alva, Oswald, and The Hooded One
Lvl 30 flask upgrade at Servi (increased recovery + charges)
Enter Jungle Ruins (top exit)
notes: Farrow doesn't have a quest here this league — he's waiting at the start of the Jungle Ruins instead

objectives.text: Talk to Farrow at the start
notes: Starts the Runeseeker chain — collect all 3 Runestones (Jungle Ruins, Venom Crypts, Azak Bog), then clear the Mystic Refuge off Infested Barrens to unlock Unique Verisium Runeforging

objectives.text: Find the Runestone (1 of 3), summon Farrow
Clear the Vaal Beacon pack (1 of 6)
notes: A red-stone ring empowers the pack around it — that dense corrupted pack is the warning. Clearing it lights a crystal toward the six needed to open the Vaal Ruins.

objectives.text: Kill Mighty Silverfist
notes: Dodge the slam SIDEWAYS (not backwards) — the wave travels in the attack direction

objectives.text: Jungle Grave (ravaged corpse) → Servi
notes: Talk to the explorers at the camps — they reveal the next area on your minimap

objectives.text: Field vendor
Find the waypoint near Venom Crypts, then enter The Venom Crypts
Clear the Vaal Beacon pack (2 of 6)
Sarcophagus event
Find the Runestone (2 of 3), summon Farrow
Find the corpse, loot the Orok Poison, head to the safe zone (A Reprieve), then TP to town
Hand the Orok Poison to Servi — PERMANENT CHOICE
notes: Cannot be changed later: +25% Stun Threshold (popular), +30% Elemental Ailment Threshold, or +25% Mana Regen

objectives.text: Head to Infested Barrens (via the Jungle Ruins for now)
Clear the Vaal Beacon pack (3 of 6)
Find and talk to Alva, take the waypoint near her
Troubled Camp (Sebastian Carroway)
Enter Chimeral Wetlands
Clear the Vaal Beacon pack (4 of 6)
Ravaged Camp → Lost Temple Logbook (reveals the Temple of Chaos) + gold chest
Toxic Bloom point of interest (Noxious Behemoth)
Ezomyte Remnant — inscribe runes, fight the waves
Enter Temple of Chaos → take waypoint → return
notes: Run the Trial of Chaos for your 2nd Ascendancy whenever ready

objectives.text: Kill Xyclucian, the Chimera, loot the Inscribed Ultimatum
Enter Jiquani's Machinarium (behind the boss)
Use the Inscribed Ultimatum at the trial entrance
Pick favorable mods (avoid lightning runes if low Lightning Res)
notes: Soul Core skip: dodge roll between the slam and twist of the placement animation — duplicates the core into all sockets

objectives.text: Complete the trial
Summon/talk to Alva, loot a Small Soul Core, use it on the Stone Altar
notes: Layout is a squared U-shape, generators at opposite tips

objectives.text: Loot 3 Small Soul Cores to open doors
Open the door, kill Blackjaw, use the Flame Core
Open another door, enter Jiquani's Sanctum
Summon/talk to Alva
Loot 2 Medium Soul Cores, place them in the Generators
Clear the Vaal Beacon pack (5 of 6)
notes: Paquate's Mechanism (a corruption altar, Vaal-orb-style item corruption) also sits in the Sanctum — use it while you clear

objectives.text: Back to start → click the Large Soul Core → kill Zicoatl, Warden of the Core → loot the core
TP to the Jungle Ruins
Use the Large Soul Core on the Stone Altar to resurface the Matlan Waterways entrance
Enter The Matlan Waterways
Narag's Hut → kill Narag of the Vile Word
Walk over the pressure pads (auto-activate on contact), proceed to the end
notes: Levers became walk-over pads and the final canal is pre-drained — just walk straight through

objectives.text: Clear the final Vaal Beacon pack (6 of 6)
notes: Completes the set and opens the portal to the Vaal Ruins — enter promptly, since the entrance can disappear and stall the quest. The storyline continues in the Interludes.

objectives.text: Hut → kill the rare
Ravaged Corpse at the Azak Bog entrance → summon Servi
notes: Servi only appears here, at the entrance — not inside Azak Bog

objectives.text: Take the Azak Bog side entrance (off the Waterways)
Talk to Farrow at the start
notes: Farrow holds this act's Runestone here, not Servi

objectives.text: Flameskin rituals
notes: Boss arena is always top-right; reset-farm magic packs around the fire shrine for XP

objectives.text: Kill Ignagduk, the Bog Witch, use the Gemrot Skull
Activate the Runestone (3 of 3)
Return Ignagduk's Ghastly Spear to Servi in town, then TP back to town
With all 3 Runestones found, return to Infested Barrens and enter the Mystic Refuge (the locked jungle vault)
Clear the Mystic Refuge, talk to Farrow
Downstairs → talk to Alva
Enter The Drowned City (bottom exit)
Scout exits to Apex of Filth and The Molten Vault
notes: Enter each, take the waypoint, then return
Layout mirrors Utzaal — the post-bridge chokepoint here is where Viper later ambushes in Utzaal

objectives.text: TP to The Molten Vault (1st char) or town
Kill Mektul, the Forgemaster (1st char only)
notes: Return the Hammer of Kamasa to Oswald in town to unlock the bench; skip on alts
Has a roughly 4-minute molten-flood timer — bring Fire Resistance

objectives.text: Frost Cores → Stone Altars clear the Molten Flow blockages
TP back to town, talk to Oswald, then TP to Apex of Filth
Find 3 Mushrooms → use the Cauldron
notes: The Cauldron Keeper is also a secret vendor — caster gear + jewellery

objectives.text: Kill the Queen of Filth, loot the Temple Door Idol
notes: Stay close to her — moving away triggers her rolling slam ultimate

objectives.text: TP back to town
Downstairs in town → talk to Alva → door behind her → enter Temple of Kopec
Kill Ketzuli, High Priest of the Sun (upstairs)
notes: Each floor is a triangle — the far corner has a 50% chance of being correct; check it first
Indoors, sunlight stacks a burning debuff — stay in the shade between packs

objectives.text: Talk to Alva, wait for the lore
In town take the Gateway, then downstairs → enter Utzaal
notes: Same layout as the Drowned City — follow the paved road, it leads to Viper

objectives.text: Farm the Sacrificial Heart from Vaal Goliaths (canister on shoulder)
notes: Can also drop in Aggorat — only this monster type drops it

objectives.text: Chaos Statue
notes: Grants an Inscribed Ultimatum, usable at the Temple of Chaos

objectives.text: Side doors for idols
notes: Sell idols to Oswald for gold

objectives.text: Kill Viper Napuatzi
notes: Highly mobile and evasive — bait her first attack cycle to predict her

objectives.text: Enter Aggorat
Find the Sacrificial Altar (top right of map)
notes: Town crier chanting points you the right way; edge of the pyramid = boss

objectives.text: Place the Sacrificial Heart, stab it with the Dagger
League mechanic (Crag Tooth)
Enter The Black Chambers (top left of map)
Kill Doryani, Royal Thaumaturge (Act Boss)
notes: Three phases: caster → Doryani's Triumph mechanic below 50% life (rage gives him a fortifying buff before engaging) → airborne phase

objectives.text: Wait for loot (~30s), then TP back to town
Talk to Doryani, then again after the cataclysm
Talk to Alva → The Hooded One → Alva to travel to Act 4 (Karui Archipelago)
